roleDescriptions.admin: Full system access with complete control over all features and user management
roleDescriptions.developer: Technical access for app development, debugging, and system maintenance
roleDescriptions.member: Doctors, nurses, and medical staff with patient care and appointment management
roleDescriptions.user: Regular users with access to their own health data and appointments

featureDescriptions.analytics: View detailed analytics, reports, and insights about your healthcare data and system performance.
featureDescriptions.reports: Generate and view comprehensive reports for patients, appointments, and system metrics.
featureDescriptions.userManagement: Manage users, roles, permissions, and access controls across the healthcare system.
featureDescriptions.patientData: Access and manage patient records, medical history, and healthcare information.
featureDescriptions.systemSettings: Configure system preferences, security settings, and administrative controls.
featureDescriptions.logs: View system logs, activity history, and audit trails for security and monitoring.
featureDescriptions.notifications: Manage notifications, alerts, and communication preferences.
featureDescriptions.contentManagement: Manage app content, resources, and educational materials.
featureDescriptions.billing: Manage billing, payments, insurance, and financial transactions.
featureDescriptions.appointments: Schedule, manage, and track patient appointments and consultations.
featureDescriptions.healthRecords: Access and manage comprehensive health records and medical history.
featureDescriptions.medications: Manage medications, prescriptions, dosages, and drug interactions.
featureDescriptions.labResults: View and manage laboratory test results and diagnostic reports.
featureDescriptions.prescriptions: Manage prescriptions, refills, and medication orders.
featureDescriptions.telemedicine: Virtual consultations, video calls, and remote healthcare services.
featureDescriptions.emergencyContacts: Manage emergency contact information and quick access protocols.
